luiskr.com / core/store/state / StoreGetters

Defined in: core/store/state.ts:163

The getter facade — components read state exclusively through these accessors so the StoreState layout can evolve without touching every consumer. getLang (lowercase-l variant getlang returns the full LangState slice) returns just the locale code — both spellings exist for legacy call-site compatibility.
